list: The official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Kinds, roadmap stages, counters and missable flags are this guide's own classification, built from the official descriptions; a flag marked as a caution is a warning read from the description, not a confirmed missable, and every guide says plainly where a detail is not yet verified in the game.
sourcesNote: Name, description and grade of every trophy: the official PlayStation 5 trophy list, as listed by Exophase (exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/) and PSNProfiles (psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi); the two agree on every name, description and grade. Tracked targets (a count or an amount) are the ones PlayStation tracks, as listed by PSNProfiles. Guide text, kinds, stages and flags are this entry's own work, written from the official descriptions.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing separate to do for it. Plan the whole run around it instead: clear the missable-watch trophies while their story moments are in front of you, keep the counters moving during the story, and leave the 100% completion trophy (A Long Road) as the long tail at the end.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of the story. It is the first thing the game asks you to do, so simply start the campaign and play it through; the trophy pops as the mission completes. Nothing else is required, and it cannot be skipped over.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play the story through to the end of Chapter 1. Chapter trophies like this one are earned in order as the campaign unfolds, so no preparation is needed beyond following the mission markers; it unlocks when the chapter closes.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play the story through to the end of Chapter 2. The name is printed with asterisks exactly as PlayStation publishes it. Like the other chapter trophies it arrives in sequence as you finish the chapter's missions, with nothing extra to collect on the way.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play the story through to the end of Chapter 3. Keep following the campaign and the trophy unlocks as the chapter ends. If you are also watching the choice counter for Actions Speak Louder, make your story choices deliberately as they come up rather than rushing past them.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play the story through to the end of Chapter 4. It is the last of the four numbered chapter trophies; after it, the campaign's remaining named-mission trophies and the final mission carry you to the credits.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the campaign's final mission. This is one of only two gold trophies on the list, and it marks the end of the story: before you start it, clear the missable-watch items tied to story moments (Catch Me If You Can at VCIA, the Ocean Beach cocktail, and your story choices), because the official list gives no promise that those moments can be revisited afterwards.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the campaign. Named-mission trophies like this one unlock as part of normal story progress, in the order the game offers the missions.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is one of the campaign's set-piece missions and the trophy is awarded for finishing it, not for any score or approach, so play it however suits your build.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when the campaign offers it. Like the other named-mission trophies, it is earned by finishing the mission as part of the story, with no side conditions.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Play the campaign in order and this unlocks as the mission ends; there is no separate objective hidden in the description.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. While you are at VCIA for this mission, remember Catch Me If You Can, the trophy for making an unscheduled departure at the same airport: that one is on this guide's missable watch list precisely because its stage is a story location, so try the departure around this mission rather than assuming you can return for it.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is one of the named campaign missions; finish it as the story presents it and the trophy unlocks at the mission's end.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the game's own completion tally. This gold is the long tail of the platinum: nearly everything else on the list feeds it, so work the other stages first and use the in-game completion percentage as your checklist of what remains. Which side content the tally counts is the game's own accounting; the official description promises only the 100% figure itself, so chase the counter, not a guessed list.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts, the count PlayStation tracks for this trophy. That is far too many to leave for the end, so start early: take stunt opportunities as you cross Leonida during the story, and use the counter in this tracker to keep the total moving. The description counts completed stunts, not unique ones, so repeatable stunt spots are your friends once you find a reliable one.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); PSN's tracked target of 250 via PSNProfiles; guide text our own.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once: PlayStation tracks 9 activity types. You do not need to win or complete anything for this one, just sample every type the game offers, so it is a good early trophy: whenever a new activity icon appears on the map, try it once and tick the type off here.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); PSN's tracked target of 9 activity types via PSNProfiles; guide text our own.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.targetLabel: Shooting Range challenges with a gold medal
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, the count PlayStation tracks. A silver earned the hard way: finishing a challenge is not enough, each of the 42 needs the gold score. Work through them in batches, learn one weapon's challenge at a time, and retry immediately while the target pattern is fresh; the counter here tracks golds, not attempts.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); PSN's tracked target of 42 challenges via PSNProfiles; guide text our own.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.targetLabel: Top Fun Drone Race locations won
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location: PlayStation tracks 14 locations. A win at each is required, not just an entry, so learn each course's line with a practice run, then race it clean. Tick locations off in the counter as you win them so none is left hiding at the end.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); PSN's tracked target of 14 locations via PSNProfiles; guide text our own.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The word 'different' is the catch: repeating one easy race twenty times does not finish it, so spread your wins across the race list and use the counter to remember how many distinct wins you hold. Finishing first is what counts; entering is not enough.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); PSN's tracked target of 20 races via PSNProfiles; guide text our own.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge among the activities, learn its scoring on a first attempt, then beat his mark on the rematch. The description names a single opponent and a single win, so once his score is beaten the trophy is done.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, any one. This is among the cheapest trophies on the list: the next time you pass an arcade machine, play a game through to its end rather than walking away mid-game. It also counts toward trying every activity type for Master of None.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's mission strand through to his final mission. Side strands like Andy's run alongside the campaign: work each of his missions as they appear so the strand's finale unlocks, then finish it. Completing strands also feeds Strangers & Freaks, which counts eight finished strands.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission. Keep Kenton's strand moving whenever his missions are offered, and the trophy arrives with the strand's last job. It is one of the strands that can count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's mission strand through to his final mission. Billy's jobs form one of the stranger strands: finish each as it appears so the finale opens, and count the strand toward the eight that Strangers & Freaks asks for.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida, the count PlayStation tracks. The named strands on this list (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) each end in their own trophy, so finishing those five is most of the way; find the remaining strands as you explore, and use the counter to track finished strands rather than started ones, because only completed strands count.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); PSN's tracked target of 8 strands via PSNProfiles; guide text our own.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's mission strand through to his final mission. Work Randy's jobs as they are offered until the strand closes with its finale, and count the finished strand toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission. As with the other named strands, the trophy is for the strand's last job, so keep returning to Tyrone until no more of his missions are offered, and count the strand toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida: PlayStation tracks 18 spots. Treat it as a collectible route: whenever you clear a new area (which also feeds The Goodtime State), sweep it for its meditation spot before moving on, and log each one in the counter so the last few are easy to hunt down.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); PSN's tracked target of 18 spots via PSNProfiles; guide text our own.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks about. Bret's request sits with the side content: take it on when his strand offers it, track the one specific animal rather than hunting generally, and the trophy unlocks when that animal is brought in. The official description names a single unique animal, so one successful hunt is the whole job.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets, the count PlayStation tracks. Note the wording: the trophy counts finished sets, not individual cards, so pick three sets and complete them fully instead of spreading single cards across every set. Track set completions in the counter; individual cards on the way are progress, not the metric.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); PSN's tracked target of 3 sets via PSNProfiles; guide text our own.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 locations, the count PlayStation tracks. A silver built on a big round number: this is a route trophy, best cleared area by area as you explore Leonida, alongside the meditation spots and area discovery. Log locations in the counter in batches; one hundred is too many to reconstruct from memory at the end.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); PSN's tracked target of 100 locations via PSNProfiles; guide text our own.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges, the count PlayStation tracks. Challenges sit beside the activities, so the efficient route is to finish challenges as you meet them while sampling activity types for Master of None, rather than grinding fifty at the end. The counter here keeps the running total honest.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); PSN's tracked target of 50 challenges via PSNProfiles; guide text our own.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a wanted level to 4 stars, then lose it and escape. The conditions are all in the description: the partner must be with you, the level must reach 4 stars (not fewer), and you must actually break the pursuit rather than be caught. Deliberately provoke the level somewhere with open escape routes, then hide out until the heat clears.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, keeping your wanted level alive the whole time. The trap is the middle condition: if the wanted level fully clears between shops, the chain breaks. Pick three shops close together, move fast between them, and keep the pressure on so the level never lapses until the third robbery is done.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles, the count PlayStation tracks. Discovery is about variety, not ownership: get into vehicles you have not used before whenever you see a new model, across rich and poor districts alike, since each area spawns different traffic. The counter keeps count of distinct discoveries as you go.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); PSN's tracked target of 100 vehicles via PSNProfiles; guide text our own.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside one activation of Combat Focus. Set the moment up rather than hoping for it: let a group of at least five enemies gather in the open, position with a loaded weapon, then trigger Combat Focus and work through them before it ends. If a use falls short, the trophy simply waits for a better crowd.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: Caution, read from the official description: the stage is VCIA, the airport the story visits in the mission VCIA Takedown, and the list nowhere promises the moment can be replayed. Flagged as a missable watch item from the description alone; not yet verified in the game.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: leave the airport in a way the schedule never planned, most naturally by taking an aircraft out without clearance. Because VCIA is a story location (the mission VCIA Takedown, trophy Hi-Jacked), do this around that mission while the airport is open to you, instead of assuming free-roam access later. Exactly which departure the game counts is not spelled out in the official description and is not yet verified, so try a clear, deliberate takeoff from VCIA airspace and watch for the pop.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); the VCIA Takedown mission named in the same official list; guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The official description is a joke line, not an instruction: 'Rhinos' are the series' tanks, so this trophy concerns an encounter with a Rhino tank. Honest position: the description alone does not pin down whether you must survive one, destroy one or ride in one, and that trigger is not yet verified in the game. When a Rhino appears, engage with it rather than fleeing, and expect the trophy around that encounter; do not trust any source that states the exact trigger as fact this early.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description, with the trigger plainly marked unverified.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get through it undetected. The whole condition is the stealth: plan the entry and exit before you start, keep weapons and noise down, and leave before attention arrives. If a robbery goes loud, it does not count against you; simply set up a quieter attempt at another store.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.targetLabel: Bank Vaults robbed with an escape
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape after each, the count PlayStation tracks. Both halves matter: a vault robbery only counts when you also get away, so plan the escape before the robbery, not during it. Repeatable in free roam, which makes this a cleanup-stage silver; log each successful vault in the counter.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); PSN's tracked target of 5 vaults via PSNProfiles; guide text our own.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. One truck is enough, but the escape is part of the trophy: crack the truck, take what it carries, and lose the attention that follows. Armored trucks are free-roam encounters, so keep an eye out while travelling rather than hunting a fixed spawn the description never names.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: PlayStation tracks 52 areas. Work the map region by region and pair the sweep with the other exploration trophies, the meditation spots and WAiNK locations, so one journey clears several counters at once. The counter here tracks areas visited; save the out-of-the-way corners for a deliberate final sweep.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); PSN's tracked target of 52 areas via PSNProfiles; guide text our own.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.targetLabel: gangs whose Illegal Operation you robbed
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang: PlayStation tracks 9 gangs. Variety is the condition, so robbing the same gang's operation nine times leaves you at one of nine. Spread the robberies across the map's territories, and use the counter to record which gangs are done so the last holdouts are easy to identify.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); PSN's tracked target of 9 gangs via PSNProfiles; guide text our own.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableNote: Caution, read from the official description and the trophy's own name: 'In The Beginning…' plus a quiet scripted-sounding moment on Ocean Beach reads like an early-game scene. Do it at the first opportunity; flagged as a missable watch item from the description alone, not yet verified in the game.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The trophy's name, In The Beginning…, and the gentle wording suggest a small scripted moment rather than a free-roam system, most likely early in the story around Ocean Beach. Take the moment when the game offers it instead of walking past: sit, order the cocktail, and let the scene play out. If it is offered again in free roam, no harm done; the caution costs nothing.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description, with the timing plainly marked unverified.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, in a vehicle, through the glass. The description asks for the exit, not a purchase: get into a car inside a showroom and drive out through the front rather than the door. It is a one-off free-roam feat, repeatable until it pops.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley, the one venue the description names. Head to that alley and play a game through; 'follow-through' is the alley's joke, not an extra condition. Bowling also counts as one of the activity types sampled for Master of None.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The official description is a riddle, not a route: 'a partnership with mass appeal' points at something done together with your partner that draws a crowd or an audience. Honest position: the description alone does not identify the exact act, and it is not yet verified in the game. The practical approach is to try partnered activities and public feats with your partner as you play, and to distrust any guide that names a precise trigger as settled fact this early.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description, with the trigger plainly marked unverified.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Caution, read from the official description: choices are made as the story unfolds, and the list does not say every choice can be made again after the credits. With a tracked target of 500, keep choosing deliberately from the start rather than skipping prompts; flagged as a caution from the description alone, not a confirmed missable.
trophies.guide: Make choices, for better or worse: PlayStation tracks the count to 500. Choices are offered as you play, in conversations and decisions, so the efficient play is simply never to idle past one: answer prompts, pick options, and let the counter accumulate from the opening hours instead of facing a shortfall after the credits. Whether every choice can be repeated in free roam is not stated in the official description, which is why this guide flags it as a caution and starts the count in stage 1.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); PSN's tracked target of 500 choices via PSNProfiles; guide text our own.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description promises a trophy about failing once and succeeding on the second attempt, but does not say at what. Honest position: the exact activity is not identified by the official description and is not yet verified in the game. The natural reading is a retryable challenge or attempt somewhere in the activities; when you fail something and immediately retry it, you are doing what this trophy describes, so do not rage-quit a failed first attempt: take the second try.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description, with the trigger plainly marked unverified.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. The description is written as a reaction, not a direction: this is the list's weird-event trophy, the kind earned by stumbling on one of the world's odd encounters rather than by completing a task. Honest position: which event, and where, is not stated in the official description and is not yet verified. Explore off the main routes, especially at night and away from the city, and investigate anything that looks out of place.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description, with the event plainly marked unverified.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by: strike a pedestrian or enemy with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Line up a slow pass beside a target, swing as you pass, and the trophy is in the contact. It is a one-off feat, so once the timing clicks it is done; a bicycle or slow car gives you the steadiest platform, though the description does not limit the vehicle.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); guide text our own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts, the amount PlayStation tracks. This is an earner, not a one-off: feed marked bills to your laundering contacts whenever you hold them, across the whole playthrough, and the total climbs. The counter here tracks dollars laundered; if you are short late, marked bills come from the robbery economy, so pair this with the vault and operation robberies in this stage.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); PSN's tracked target of $250,000 via PSNProfiles; guide text our own.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, the amount PlayStation tracks. 'Across all shops' means the total is cumulative everywhere, so ordinary play does most of it: buy vehicles, clothes, weapons and services as you go rather than hoarding cash, and the counter here shows the running spend. If you finish the story short, a deliberate shopping round closes the gap.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); PSN's tracked target of $100,000 via PSNProfiles; guide text our own.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: PlayStation tracks 8. Buy each garage as your money allows across the playthrough rather than saving for a single spree; the counter records purchases, and the eighth garage completes it. Garage money competes with the $100,000 spending trophy only in your wallet, since buying property and spending in shops are tracked separately by their own descriptions.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); PSN's tracked target of 8 garages via PSNProfiles; guide text our own.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.targetLabel: vehicles registered to the Scooter Bros app
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, the count PlayStation tracks. Registration is a habit to build early: whenever you take a vehicle you like, register it in the app there and then, and ten accumulate quickly alongside the 100 vehicles Whip It Good asks you to discover. The counter tracks registrations, not discoveries.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 list via Exophase and PSNProfiles (name, description, grade); PSN's tracked target of 10 vehicles via PSNProfiles; guide text our own.
